title: Preparation of Mesh-Shaped Engineered Cardiac Tissues Derived from Human iPS Cells for In Vivo Myocardial Repair
protocol: Expand and maintain hiPSCs on thin-coat basement membrane matrix in conditioned medium extracted from mouse embryonic fibroblasts (MEF-CM) with human basic fibroblast growth factor (hbFGF).
Detach and dissociate cells using Versene when cell confluency reaches 90-100%.
Plate cells at a density of 10,000 cells/mm² on matrix-coated cell culture plates in MEF-CM with hbFGF and culture for two to three days.
Cover the cells with matrix (1:60 dilution with MEF-CM) for one day when the culture becomes fully confluent.
Replace the MEF-CM with RPMI 1640 + B27 medium.
Add 100 ng/mL of Activin A and 100 ng/mL of Wnt3A to the medium for one day.
On day 1 of differentiation, change the medium to new RPMI 1640 + B27 with 10 ng/mL of BMP4 and 10 ng/mL of hbFGF.
Culture cells for two (MC protocol) or four (CM+EC protocol) days without medium change.
Replace the medium on day 5 of differentiation with RPMI 1640 + B27 supplemented with 50 ng/mL of VEGF165.
Change the culture medium every 48 h until day 13‒15 of differentiation for CM+EC protocol.
Replace the medium with RPMI1640 + 10% fetal bovine serum (FBS) at day 3 of differentiation for MC protocol.
Change the culture medium every 48 h until day 13‒15 of differentiation for MC protocol.
Wash the cells with Ca2+ and Mg2+ free phosphate-buffered saline (PBS).
Add cell dissociation solution in the cell culture dish to cover the plate.
Incubate the plate for 5 min at 37 °C.
Collect and dissociate the cells with culture medium using a pipette after incubation.
Allocate 1 x 106 cells for lineage analysis with flow cytometry.
Stain the cells with fixable viability dye to eliminate dead cells.
Stain cells with anti-PDGFRβ antibody diluted 1:100 in FACS staining buffer.
Stain cells with anti-VE cadherin antibody diluted 1:100 in FACS staining buffer.
Stain cells with anti-TRA-1-60 antibody diluted 1:20 in FACS staining buffer.
Resuspend and fix the cells with 4% paraformaldehyde (PFA) in PBS.
Stain the cells with anti-cardiac isoform of Troponin T (cTnT) in PBS with 5% FBS and 0.75% Saponin.
Label the cTnT antibody with 488 mouse IgG1 diluted 1:50.
Resuspend the stained cells in PBS with 5% FBS.
Place the resuspended cells in FACS tubes with cell strainer.
Analyze the cell composition of the stained cells from each differentiation protocol with flow cytometry.
Mix the prepolymer and cross-linking solution at a ratio of 10:1 to cast a PDMS layer.
Cure the mixed PDMS mixture at 80 °C for 3 hours.
Cut the cured PDMS sheet to fabricate a rectangular tray.
Bond the cut PDMS sheet with silicone adhesive to create posts at staggered positions within the tray.
Autoclave the fabricated tray at 120 °C for 20 minutes.
Coat the tray with 1% poloxamer 407 in PBS.
Rinse the poloxamer 407 from the tray.
Rinse the mold with PBS sufficiently prior to use.
Combine cells from CM+EC and MC protocols so that the final concentration of MCs is 10 to 20% in a total cell number of six million cells per construct.
Suspend mixed six million cells in ECT culture medium (alpha minimum essential medium supplemented with 10% FBS, 50 µM 2-mercaptoethanol and 100 U/mL Penicillin-Streptomycin).
Mix 133 µL of acid-soluble rat tail collagen type I solution (2 mg/mL, pH 3) with 17 µL of 10x minimum essential medium (MEM).
Add 17 µL of alkali buffer (0.2 M NaHCO3, 0.2 M HEPES, and 0.1 M NaOH) to the collagen-MEM mixture.
Check if the medium becomes pinkish after adding the alkali buffer; add additional alkali buffer if necessary.
Add 67 µL of basement membrane matrix to the neutralized collagen solution.
Keep the mixed collagen solution on ice (4 °C).
Centrifuge the prepared cell suspension containing six million cells at 1,100 rpm (240 x g) for 5 min.
Resuspend the cells with 167 µL of high-glucose DMEM + 20% FBS + 1% penicillin-streptomycin (100x).
Mix the cell suspension and the matrix solution to a total volume of 400 μL per construct.
Keep the cell/matrix mixture on ice as it will solidify at room temperature.
Pour the non-viscous, pinkish cell/matrix mixture evenly over the poloxamer 407 coated PDMS tissue mold in a six-well culture plate carefully to avoid generating bubbles.
Incubate the poured gel in a standard CO2 incubator (37°C, 5% CO2) for 60 min.
Soak the tissue mold with 4 mL of ECT culture medium gently after the tissue is formed to avoid damaging the fragile construct.
Culture the tissue for 14 days with daily medium changes.
Remove the ECT from the loading posts gently using sterilized fine forceps.
Hold the unloaded ECT softly with fine forceps in warm culture medium.
Attach the ECT to the epicardium using 7-0 silk suture.
